# SongIQ

> SongIQ is a free online music quiz game where you guess songs and artists from 15-second audio clips. It supports Solo, Daily Challenge, friend Challenges and real-time Multiplayer modes, and covers music across genres and eras (Pop, Hip-Hop & Rap, R&B, UK Drill & Grime, Gospel, 90s and 2000s throwbacks, live country charts and artist playlists), including one of the deepest catalogues of African music (Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife). No signup required. Play at https://songiq.io

**What is SongIQ?** SongIQ is a free browser-based music trivia game. You listen to a 15-second song preview and guess either the song title or the artist from four options. Points are awarded for speed and accuracy.

**Is SongIQ free?** Yes. SongIQ is completely free to play with no signup, no downloads, and no ads required to start.

**Can you play SongIQ with friends?** Yes. Create a private multiplayer room for up to 25 players, share the link, and compete in real time with a live leaderboard. The host picks the playlist, number of songs (5–20), and round time limit (10–30 seconds). You can also finish a solo game and send a challenge link so friends can try to beat your score.

**What devices does SongIQ work on?** Any modern browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile. No app install required.

**What genres does SongIQ cover?** All the major ones: Pop, Hip-Hop & Rap, R&B, UK Drill & Grime, Gospel, 90s and 2000s throwbacks, live country charts (Trending US, Trending UK, Trending Nigeria and more), and African genres like Afrobeats, Amapiano and Highlife. There are also artist playlists, from Taylor Swift, Rihanna, Ed Sheeran and Beyoncé to Burna Boy, Wizkid and Davido.

**Is SongIQ a Heardle alternative?** Yes. SongIQ plays the same "guess the song from audio" format but adds multiplayer rooms, many more genres (including African music), and unlimited rounds (Heardle is one song per day).

**How does scoring work?** A correct answer earns 100 points plus a speed bonus of up to 100 that drains over the round, so the maximum is 200 points per song (for example: answering in 2 seconds scores 186, in 7 seconds 153, in 14 seconds 106). A wrong answer or no answer scores 0.

**What is the Daily Challenge?** One shared 10-song quiz per day, and everyone gets the same songs. Only the first attempt counts, it resets at midnight Lagos time (WAT, UTC+1), and answers are saved as you go, so closing it by accident lets you continue before midnight. Playing on consecutive days builds a streak.

**How do Points and the leaderboard work?** Every finished game earns lifetime Points: your score ÷ 100 (up to 20 for a 10-song game), plus 5 for each opponent you beat in multiplayer, plus 10/6/4 for the Daily Challenge top 3. The global leaderboard ranks players by minutes played or by Points, with weekly, monthly and all-time views. Every 15-day streak earns a Streak Save that covers one missed day.

**Who is SongIQ for?** Music fans of any genre, friend groups, party hosts and classrooms who want a quick competitive music game.

How a round works:

1. A 15-second audio preview plays automatically.
2. You see four answer options in a 2×2 grid.
3. You guess either the song title or the artist, chosen randomly each round.
4. Faster correct answers score more points.
5. After a short reveal of the correct answer, a 3-second countdown leads into the next track.
6. After the last song (10 in Solo and the Daily), a results screen shows your score, accuracy and a breakdown of every song: title, artist and whether you got it.

Technical details:

- Platform: Web (browser-based, no download required)
- Price: Free
- Accounts: Play anonymously with a nickname; optional Google sign-in keeps your nickname, points and streak across devices
- Audio: song previews via Apple Music
- Multiplayer: Real-time via WebSockets with polling fallback

## Game Modes

- [Solo Play](https://songiq.io/solo): Pick a genre, listen to 15-second clips, guess the artist or song, beat your high score.
- [Daily Challenge](https://songiq.io/daily): One shared quiz per day for everyone, with a daily leaderboard and play streaks.
- [Multiplayer](https://songiq.io/multiplayer): Host or join a room, share an invite link, compete live with friends on a shared leaderboard.
- [Challenges](https://songiq.io/challenges): Browse active challenges other players have created and try to beat their scores.
- [Leaderboard](https://songiq.io/leaderboard): Top players by points, play time and daily streak.

## Landing Pages

- [Guess the Song Game](https://songiq.io/guess-the-song-game): Hear a 15-second clip and name the track.
- [Guess the Artist Game](https://songiq.io/guess-the-artist-game): Hear a clip and name the artist behind it.
- [Song Quiz Online](https://songiq.io/song-quiz-online): Free browser-based music quiz, no signup.
- [Music Quiz Multiplayer](https://songiq.io/music-quiz-multiplayer): Up to 25 players in a live room.
- [Heardle Alternative](https://songiq.io/heardle-alternative): Unlimited rounds and multiplayer, no daily cap.
- [Afrobeats Quiz](https://songiq.io/afrobeats-quiz): Burna Boy, Wizkid, Tems, Davido, Asake and more.
- [Amapiano Quiz](https://songiq.io/amapiano-quiz): Kabza, Maphorisa, Tyler ICU, Uncle Waffles and more.
- [African Music Quiz](https://songiq.io/african-music-quiz): Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Bongo Flava.
